scope: Planned material-property families; no physical-property pipeline is implemented in this starter.
counting_rule: Tensor components, uncertainty columns and algebraically derived outputs are not independent validated capabilities.

families.label: Thermodynamics
families.acceptance_gate: Equilibrated ensemble and observable-specific fluctuation gates

families.label: Thermal transport
families.acceptance_gate: Heat flux or thermal-gradient protocol; finite-size checks

families.label: Chain statistics
families.acceptance_gate: Unwrapped chemically ordered chains; contour and chain-length checks

families.label: Chemical association
families.acceptance_gate: Document geometric definitions and intermittent/continuous lifetime conventions

families.label: Free volume
families.acceptance_gate: Define probe radius, geometric algorithm, and snapshot sampling

families.label: Structure and scattering
families.acceptance_gate: Scattering weights, periodic boundaries and finite q-resolution

families.label: Elasticity
families.acceptance_gate: Finite-T stress averaging; small-strain and isotropy/symmetry checks

families.label: Nonlinear mechanics
families.acceptance_gate: Strain rate, stress convention, thermostat and lateral boundary conditions

families.label: Viscoelasticity
families.acceptance_gate: Linear-response range and accessible relaxation/frequency window

families.label: Rheology
families.acceptance_gate: Flow protocol and terminal relaxation; no zero-shear extrapolation without evidence

families.label: Sorption and swelling
families.acceptance_gate: Chemical-potential or activity controlled equilibrium; glass hysteresis assessment

families.label: Molecular and membrane transport
families.acceptance_gate: Diffusive regime, loading and solution-diffusion applicability

families.label: Ionic transport
families.acceptance_gate: Collective correlations, reference frame and finite-size tests

families.label: Surfaces and interfaces
families.acceptance_gate: Defined reference states and converged enhanced sampling

families.label: Electrical and optical response
families.acceptance_gate: Validated polarization/optical model; avoid double-counted electronic response

families.label: Spectroscopy
families.acceptance_gate: Property-specific dipole/polarizability or QM electronic response model

families.label: Electromechanics
families.acceptance_gate: Appropriate symmetry, polar state, boundary and polarization model

families.label: Transitions and aging
families.acceptance_gate: Preparation history, cooling/heating rates and timescale checks
